name: Lulu Seaburu
source: A magician who is also an idol and a miko, also what Kanade's transformation looks like. For some reason, when she transforms, she becomes very young-looking, which is why nobody believes her when she claims to be an adult.
translation: A magician who is also an idol and a miko, also what Kanade's transformation looks like. For some reason, when she transforms, she becomes very young-looking, which is why nobody believes her when she claims to be an adult.
